summary: Master Precision Agriculture and Farm Digitalisation with AI, IoT, and drones. Enroll in our advanced 5-day course to optimize yields and reduce costs.
lede: GNSS supports precision agriculture by mapping fields and helping teams delineate management zones for operational decisions. This training is for professionals in farm operations, agronomy, machinery, geospatial data, or agricultural technology who need to turn farm data into field-level action. It covers validating sensor data, interpreting satellite imagery, designing variable-rate prescription maps, integrating machinery data, and reporting farm performance metrics.
audienceIntro: Precision agriculture training is designed for advanced professionals who already work with farm operations, agronomy, machinery, geospatial data, or agricultural technology and need to integrate digital systems into practical decision workflows.

prerequisites: Prior experience with farm operations, agronomy, agricultural machinery, GIS, farm-management software, or agricultural data analysis is expected. You should be comfortable interpreting field records and operational metrics. No programming is required for completion, although basic spreadsheet skills and familiarity with digital farm platforms will help. Advanced AI, sensor, and automation topics are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering or production deployment level.
